interventions.description: Install a continuous paved sidewalk on the near side of the street to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Mid-block Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions at potential crossing points to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers by moving the waiting area past the line of parked cars.
